Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the target “legendary figure featured in Historia Regum Britanniae” as Merlin and pursued Elliot Knight, despite the question likely referring to King Arthur (also central to Historia Regum Britanniae and featured in Once Upon a Time, played by Liam Garrigan). The ambiguity wasn’t resolved, leading the workflow to confirm the wrong figure.
